description: Standalone apply_patch utility from OpenAI Codex's agent patch system, mirrored as a ready-to-install binary bundle.
notes: Unofficial community mirror of OpenAI Codex's apply_patch binary, published by a third-party maintainer (BeautyyuYanli) and rebuilt automatically from upstream openai/codex releases.
The Windows executable is unsigned (no Authenticode); integrity is protected by this per-version pinned SHA-256, verified at install time.
apply_patch is a structured patch applier: it reads, writes, moves, and deletes files in the working directory. Review the patch content it is given.
